title: CAS-ANSO Scholarship 2027 (Master's and PhD at UCAS)
institution: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)
field: Science and technology (master's and doctoral programmes)
about: The CAS-ANSO Scholarship 2027 supports non-Chinese citizens applying for master's or PhD study at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences. Applications opened on 17 November 2026; the deadline for applicants and referees is 28 February 2027 (Beijing time).
requirements: Non-Chinese citizen with a valid passport
Master's applicants born after 1 January 1997; PhD applicants born after 1 January 1992
High level of English proficiency (HSK 5, 180+, for Chinese-taught programmes)
